objective: Maximize event-level F1 across fixed exact-oracle-call budgets while returning distinct, oracle-supported events under one shared materializer.
query_text: a vehicle, pedestrian, or cyclist entering the ego vehicle's path from outside the driving corridor

heldout.name: realcartest_2000_3200
heldout.source_video_status: original video missing; exact-time frames reconstructed from retained overlapping 5-second clips

candidate.name: Query-Temporal Peak Contrast
candidate.budget_policy: take the first B units of the single nested ranking
candidate.selection_disclosure: Radius 8 was selected on dataset3 after an exploratory dyadic sweep over 1,2,4,8,16,32. It is not claimed to be label-free tuning.
candidate.heldout_rule: Apply radius 8 unchanged; do not tune or switch methods using heldout labels.

baselines.temporal_nms_h8: greedy CLIP ranking with +/-8-unit hard suppression, then CLIP-order fill
baselines.temporal_nms_h10_dev_selected: greedy CLIP ranking with +/-10-unit hard suppression, then CLIP-order fill
baselines.mmr: CLIP relevance percentile and cosine embedding similarity; lambda=0.5
baselines.facility_location: query-weighted semantic facility location; development specification recorded by the runner
baselines.bsec: semantic-temporal monotone-submodular cover; development specification recorded by the runner
baselines.arc_shared_k3: ARC queried units rematerialized with the same k3_bridge_safe operator
baselines.arc_native_descriptive: historical native ARC output; descriptive only because its materializer and returned duration differ
baselines.random: uniform random nested rankings over fixed seeds
baselines.oracle_ceiling: positive units first; diagnostic upper bound

decision_rule.development_go: QTPC F1-AUC exceeds CLIP top-k, ARC-shared-K3, MMR, facility location, BSEC, and both frozen temporal-NMS baselines.
decision_rule.heldout_replication: QTPC F1-AUC exceeds CLIP top-k and ARC-shared-K3, improves at least four of six budget points over CLIP, and uses exactly B oracle observations at every budget.
decision_rule.native_arc_interpretation: Native ARC is reported but cannot be a fair primary gate unless materialization and returned-duration contracts are equalized.
decision_rule.failure_action: If heldout replication fails, reject QTPC as a general method and continue mechanism search without changing this frozen file.
